correctness.rationale: An independent exhaustive Python census (/workspace/checks/kempe_gp83.py, run with python3) checks all eight-edge subsets for perfect matchings and all pairs of distinct named states for a move. Properness forces the changed support for a given transposition to have degree two at each moved vertex; its connectedness is thus exactly the one-cycle condition. Projecting named adjacencies and dropping loops gives 33 matchings, 20 partitions and 27 quotient edges. The stated bijection sends the complete 16-state component edge set to the base-graph edge set; the other component is the claimed star. Breadth-first distances from all named states confirm components of size 24 and 96, edge totals 54 and 288, the degree histograms and radii/diameters 3 and 4. The frozen transcript is consistent with, but is not the basis of, the independent count.

value.rationale: The self-copy would be a useful structural fact if uncovered, but is an exact repeat of an already proved natural invariant. Most named-graph sizes and degree data are consequences of the older cycle profiles.
